captions_note: the large captions are part of the effect: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions while they run (work/reel_captions.json). Set the cap_ lines in STYLE to the reel's caption style. CAPTIONS=0 draws none and the reel's captions keep running
in_a_reel: CLIPS holds the buyer's own walkthrough video. No video from the buyer = leave the effect out
chapter names are the buyer's own words; no real product's logo or interface
the buyer's style wins: set the plate and the cap_ lines in the STYLE block before the first build
steps: put the buyer's walkthrough video in the slot's clips folder and fill CHAPTERS and END_WORD in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the beats and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: clips
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own walkthrough video (mp4 or mov, one video or one per chapter). Only material they may show
